record.context_brief: Weak local lifting for groups of order p^3
record.original_question: Let G be a nonabelian group of order p^3. Does G have the weak local lifting property, meaning that some faithful action G -> Aut_k k[[z]] lifts to an action G -> Aut_R R[[Z]] for a discrete valuation ring R finite over W(k)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime number, let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of characteristic $p$, and let $W(k)$ denote the ring of Witt vectors of $k$. For a finite $p$-group $G$, say that $G$ has the weak local lifting property if there exist:
(i) a discrete valuation ring $R$ that is finite over $W(k)$ with residue field $k$;
(ii) a faithful continuous $k$-linear action $i : G \to \mathrm{Aut}_k\, k[[z]]$; and
(iii) a continuous $R$-linear action $I : G \to \mathrm{Aut}_R\, R[[Z]]$
such that $I$ reduces modulo the maximal ideal of $R$ to $i$ (i.e., the action $I$ on $R[[Z]]$ specializes to $i$ on $k[[z]] = R[[Z]] \otimes_R k$ under a compatible choice of uniformizers).

Question: Let $G$ be a nonabelian group of order $p^3$. Does $G$ have the weak local lifting property?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on the local lifting problem and weak Oort groups indicate that the local lifting problem has been resolved for cyclic groups (Obus–Wewers and Pop) and studied for specific small groups such as $A_4$ and $D_4$, but no source found explicitly settles the weak local lifting property for general nonabelian groups of order $p^3$ (e.g., the Heisenberg group mod $p$). The status of the question appears to remain unresolved in the literature found.

status_evidence.title: Cyclic Extensions and the Local Lifting Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Obus–Wewers proved the local lifting conjecture for cyclic groups under conditions; Pop completed the cyclic case.
status_evidence.claim: Cyclic case resolved, but nonabelian p^3 case not addressed.

status_evidence.title: The Local Lifting Problem for D_4
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the local lifting problem for the specific nonabelian 2-group D_4.
status_evidence.claim: Specific small nonabelian groups treated case by case; no general resolution for nonabelian p^3.

status_evidence.title: An obstruction to the local lifting problem
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on obstructions to local lifting; nonabelian p^3 groups not declared resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research; weak local lifting for nonabelian order-p^3 groups not stated as solved.
